prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Raju bhai, Vicky, Raju K, Sunita didi.
The chat covers 04/03/26, 8:30 pm to 04/03/26, 10:30 pm. It must have exactly 23 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
04/03/26, 9:14 pm - Raju bhai: Vicky, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.

nonce: 5
text:
04/03/26, 8:30 pm - Sunita didi: Haan bhai, aaj ka UPI practice scenario shuru karein?
04/03/26, 8:35 pm - Raju K: Haan didi, main ready hoon. Aaj kaunsa case study hai?
04/03/26, 8:40 pm - Vicky: Sunita didi, fake QR code scan wala scenario try karte hain.
04/03/26, 8:44 pm - Raju bhai: Vicky pehle PIN maangne wala customer setup kar le.
04/03/26, 8:48 pm - Sunita didi: Direct PIN mat maango, bole ki 'money receive' karne ke liye PIN daalna padega.
04/03/26, 8:52 pm - Raju K: Sahi trick hai didi, lagbhag sabhi naye log isme phans jaate hain.
04/03/26, 8:57 pm - Vicky: Maine test account me ₹500 ka request bhej diya hai.
04/03/26, 9:01 pm - Raju K: Transaction complete dikha raha hai dashboard pe.
04/03/26, 9:05 pm - Sunita didi: Good, ab audit log check karo sabhi.
04/03/26, 9:08 pm - Raju K: Audit log me UPI reference number reflect ho gaya hai.
04/03/26, 9:11 pm - Vicky: Haan, entry visible hai test server par.
04/03/26, 9:14 pm - Raju bhai: Vicky, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
04/03/26, 9:18 pm - Vicky: Done Raju bhai, record clear kar diya.
04/03/26, 9:22 pm - Sunita didi: Aise delete nahi karna hota training database se, backup kaun rakhega?
04/03/26, 9:28 pm - Raju K: Ha didi, roll-back command use karna chahiye tha.
04/03/26, 9:35 pm - Raju bhai: Koi baat nahi, next simulation start karte hain phirse.
04/03/26, 9:42 pm - Sunita didi: Iss baar phishing link wala scenario test karenge.
04/03/26, 9:50 pm - Vicky: Link generate kar ke chat me share karoon kya?
04/03/26, 9:58 pm - Raju K: Haan bhai, test environment ka dummy link hi bhejna.
04/03/26, 10:07 pm - Vicky: Sent! Yeh dekho dummy banking portal ka link.
04/03/26, 10:14 pm - Sunita didi: Perfect, safe domain pe redirect ho raha hai.
04/03/26, 10:22 pm - Raju K: Aaj ki training session kafi informative thi.
04/03/26, 10:30 pm - Raju bhai: Okay team, baaki practice kal karenge, goodnight!
